holdings.name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd.

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales increased to ₹1,358 crore in June 2026, with operating profit climbing to ₹92 crore.
The company's Corporate Identification Number changed from unlisted to listed following trading on the NSE and BSE.
Institutional shareholders reduced stakes, with Qualcomm selling shares worth ₹157 crore and Newquest Asia Fund offloading shares to bring its holding to 6.69%.
The board approved the creation of a new wholly owned subsidiary and allotted 49,098 ESOP equity shares.

holdings.why_it_matters: As the fund's top holding at 3.79% weight, its 28.35% 3-month return made it the largest positive contributor (+1.074%) to the portfolio.

watch.text: Operational integration of the newly approved wholly owned subsidiary.
Any further institutional equity sales following exits by Qualcomm and Newquest.

holdings.name: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd.

what_changed.text: Sedemac commenced limited commercial production at its new manufacturing facility in Pune.
Nandan Nilekani's NRJN Family Trust and other investors offloaded an 11% stake in block transactions totaling ₹1,469 crore.
The nomination and remuneration committee approved 82,400 ESOPs at an exercise price of ₹2,700 per share, following stock exchange approvals for 9,75,000 ESOP shares.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.82% fund weight in Industrials, its 19.58% 3-month gain added 0.552% in contribution, supporting overall fund returns.

watch.text: Production volume scaling at the newly opened Pune manufacturing facility.

holdings.name: Atul Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 revenue rose to ₹1,848 crore and net profit reached ₹254 crore with an operating margin of 21%.
The Gujarat Pollution Control Board instructed the company to pause effluent discharge following pipeline damage, which was subsequently repaired alongside a ₹10 lakh bank guarantee submission.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 23, 2026 to deliberate on a proposal for a buyback of equity shares.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.11% of the fund, Atul is the largest Materials holding, where near-flat 3-month performance (-0.16%) muted sector gains.

watch.text: Board decision regarding the proposed equity share buyback on October 23, 2026.
Ongoing regulatory clearance and discharge monitoring from the GPCB.

holdings.name: Travel Food Services Ltd.

what_changed.text: Operating profit margin declined from 40% in March 2026 to 36% in June 2026, with quarterly net profit at ₹129 crore.
Whole-time Director and Chief Financial Officer Vikas Kapoor resigned on October 7, 2026.
Shareholders approved and the company remitted a final dividend of ₹10.25 per equity share for FY 2025-26.

holdings.why_it_matters: Comprising 2.07% of the portfolio, the stock's -8.85% decline over 3 months detracted from the Consumer Discretionary bucket.

watch.text: Appointment of a permanent Chief Financial Officer to replace Vikas Kapoor.

holdings.name: R R Kabel Ltd.

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales reached ₹3,168 crore and net profit rose to ₹205 crore for the period ending June 2026.
The board approved and signed a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the optical fibre cable business undertaking of U M Cables for ₹77 crore via a slump sale.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.86% fund weight, its 2.35% 3-month return provided steady performance within the Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Closing and integration milestones for the U M Cables optical fibre cable business acquisition.

holdings.name: Timken India Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit declined to ₹120 crore on revenue of ₹943 crore in June 2026, down from ₹158 crore in March 2026.
Pramesh Maheshwari was appointed President India and Southeast Asia effective October 12, 2026.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 29, 2026 to review financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.78% portfolio weight, the stock fell -8.59% over 3 months, acting as a drag alongside peer capital goods names.

watch.text: Second quarter and half-yearly earnings outcome on October 29, 2026.

holdings.name: LIC Housing Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly financing profit reached ₹1,926 crore on revenue of ₹7,083 crore in June 2026.
The company outlined plans to leverage non-housing and project loans to drive double-digit disbursement growth.
Joint General Manager I Sreedhar retired upon superannuation on August 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.72% portfolio weight, its -7.41% 3-month loss dampened the fund's 14.9% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Disbursement trajectory across non-housing and project finance segments.

holdings.name: Minda Corporation Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit grew to ₹206 crore in June 2026, while sales expanded to ₹1,846 crore.
The company agreed to acquire 26% stakes in solar companies Agganga Private Limited and Sunsure Solarpark Sixteen.
The board approved a fundraise of up to ₹500 crore through non-convertible debentures and divested its holding in EVQ Point Solutions.
The company invested ₹18 crore in subsidiary Spark Minda-Toyodenso to preserve its 60% equity share.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.66% of the portfolio, the stock shed -6.29% over 3 months, pulling back after a 17.80% gain over 6 months.

watch.text: Issuance timeline and terms for the approved ₹500 crore NCD fundraise.
Closing of captive power share subscriptions in Agganga and Sunsure Solarpark.

holdings.name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales dropped to ₹1,066 crore from ₹1,155 crore in the prior quarter, with net profit falling to ₹104 crore.
Appellate tax authorities quashed an IGST demand of ₹1.79 crore and an associated ₹17.9 lakh penalty for FY21.
The company attained NABL accreditation for its Hemi Anechoic testing chamber through July 2030.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 1.63% of fund assets, its -8.46% 3-month return contributed to pressure on the fund's Consumer Discretionary basket.

watch.text: Sequential recovery in commercial vehicle component volumes and operating margins.

holdings.name: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales remained steady at ₹935 crore in June 2026, with operating profit margin holding at 6%.
The company commissioned its Thervoykandigai plant and initiated a ₹200 crore copper cathode project.
Shareholders approved a ₹2 per share final dividend at the AGM.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.58% of the fund, the stock dropped -24.85% over 3 months, making it the fund's largest negative contributor (-0.393%).

watch.text: Execution milestones and commercial launch of the ₹200 crore copper cathode project.

portfolio.statement: ICICI Prudential Small Cap Fund holds 96.6% equity with top sector allocations in Industrials (25.3%), Materials (20.2%), and Consumer Discretionary (19.8%). Top-10 concentration is 21%, while recent returns show -3.62% over 1 month and -0.84% over 3 months.
interp: Outperformance in logistics and powertrain holdings (Shadowfax and Sedemac) offset weakness across cyclical manufacturing and metals names.
Portfolio returns reflect significant drag from metal recyclers and automotive equipment suppliers over the last quarter.
portfolio.line: Industrials winners provided support, but drops in Materials and auto equipment restrained 3-month fund performance.

drivers.text: Shadowfax Technologies surged 28.35% over 3 months, delivering a +1.074% contribution to the fund on expanding sales and margins.
SEDEMAC Mechatronics gained 19.58% over 3 months, adding +0.552% following the launch of commercial production at its Pune plant.
Pondy Oxides & Chemicals plunged -24.85% over 3 months, generating a -0.393% negative contribution despite commissioning its Thervoykandigai facility.
